blocks.text: Real-world analogue: A distributed university campus, urban service-tunnel system, watershed infrastructure, archipelago community, or transit network whose identity depends on connection among separated sites rather than one central building.
World relation: Open World exchange held inside Quiet World disclosure limits. Its “nearness” is relational and operational rather than a simple physical distance.

Connection to newer locations: Coda-Near relates to the Archipelago of Borrowed Horizons, City of Rainward Roofs, Kelp Tower Shelf, and Karst Lantern Provinces. Each is one place only because routes and responsibilities keep distant pieces in relation.
Abstract or metaphorical relation: Home can be distributed. Place is a pattern of dependable access, witness, and care rather than a single coordinate.
